types.name: BypassRequest
docs: A bypass request to withdraw above limits after a timelock.
One active per vault+member. PDA seeds: ["bypass_request", vault, member]

types.name: PendingDestinationRequest
docs: A pending request to add a withdrawal destination (timelock).
PDA seeds: ["pending_dest", vault, member, destination]

types.name: ProgramConfig
docs: Global program configuration.

types.name: RuleChangeProposal
docs: A pending proposal to change vault rules (timelock).
Only one active per vault. PDA seeds: ["rule_proposal", vault]

types.name: Vault
docs: A vault holds a single token type with withdrawal limits.
Limits can be fixed amounts (lamports) or percentage-based (bps of balance).
Personal vaults: single member, mutable rules.
Community vaults: multiple members, immutable rules, penalty redistribution.

fields.name: token_mint
docs: SPL token mint. Pubkey::default() means native SOL vault.

fields.name: daily_limit
docs: Daily withdrawal limit. Interpretation depends on `limits_are_percentage`.
Fixed mode: amount in lamports/smallest-unit. Percentage mode: basis points (e.g. 500 = 5%).

fields.name: weekly_limit
docs: Weekly withdrawal limit (same interpretation as daily_limit).

fields.name: monthly_limit
docs: Monthly withdrawal limit (same interpretation as daily_limit).

fields.name: limits_are_percentage
docs: When true, daily/weekly/monthly_limit are basis points of member balance.
When false, they are fixed amounts in lamports/smallest-unit.

fields.name: penalty_rate_bps
docs: Penalty rate for instant withdrawals beyond limits (always basis points)

fields.name: vault_nonce
docs: Creator-chosen nonce to allow multiple vaults per creator

fields.name: total_balance
docs: Sum of all member balances (excluding penalty pool)

fields.name: accumulated_penalty_per_share
docs: Accumulated penalty per share, scaled by PRECISION (reward-per-share pattern)

types.name: VaultMember
docs: Per-member state within a vault.

fields.name: penalty_debt
docs: Reward-per-share debt for penalty redistribution

fields.name: unclaimed_penalties
docs: Accumulated but unclaimed penalty rewards

types.name: WithdrawalDestination
docs: An approved withdrawal destination for a vault member.
PDA seeds: ["withdrawal_dest", vault, member, destination]
